subject: SIG follow-up: request for log schema, retention proof, and legal preservation

From: Jordan Price <security@clearview.com>

Cc: security_ops@clearview.com
Date: Sat, 24 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: specific log evidence and preservation request

Naomi,

Thanks again for the SIG submission last week — the team reviewed your responses and we have a few follow-ups that are blocking our InfoSec review. Specifically we need: 

1) A copy of the audit log schema (field list + types) for tenant event streams for the last 30 days.
2) A signed statement of retention policy that covers audit logs and who can request exports.
3) Procedure for granting ephemeral access (time-limited S3 presigned URL or role) to customer-supplied audit evidence.
4) Confirmation of legal preservation / hold process if Clearview requests an e-discovery hold for a subset of events (tenant-level).

Can you provide the artifacts or point me to where to validate them? We prefer a short delivery (attachments or Drive link) and a named contact we can escalate to if anything in the artifacts needs clarification.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Price

- We support time-limited presigned S3 URLs for customer evidence exports; I will include the standard instructions and TTL options.
- Legal preservation/hold: we have an internal intake that captures the scope and creates an export hold. That process is documented and Rafael will add the steps and contacts.

Target: I can get the initial package to you by Monday morning (2026-10-26 09:00 PT). If you need faster, tell me the specific fields you need and Rafael can prioritize a sample export.

Named contact for escalation: Marissa Cole (marissa_cole@redwood.com) — she'll handle cross-team coordination.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Folks — attaching the artifacts for Jordan. Summary of what I included and operational notes: 

Attachments: audit_log_schema_v3.csv, retention_policy_redacted_signed.pdf, s3_temp_access_instructions.txt

Operational notes (short):
- Schema: covers tenant_id, event_ts (ISO8601), event_type, user_id (hashed), request_id, model_id, request_payload_redacted, response_code, origin_ip (first 3 octets masked), kv_cache_hit boolean, compute_node_id (internal)
- Sample export: I created a 30-day anonymized sample and verified parity with schema; we will upload to a pre-auth Drive folder for Clearview if preferred.
- Ephemeral access: We provide presigned S3 URLs with TTLs of 1 hour / 6 hours / 24 hours. URLs are one-time use by default and access is logged (actor, IP, timestamp).
- Legal preservation: Intake form (legal@redwood.com) -> Preservation ticket -> create immutable export (write-once bucket) -> retention owner notified. Typical turnaround for scoped tenant-level preservation is 48-72 hours; for broader requests we surface to engineering.

Next steps: Marissa to coordinate signature/cover note; Naomi to send to Jordan. If Clearview requests an e-discovery hold, Rafael (infra) and Legal will be named contacts.

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
